scope: exploratory local loopback, not a dedicated droplet qualification
cpp_profile: clang++ -std=c++23 -O3 -DNDEBUG; pinned CMake Release libraries with OpenSSL enabled
placement_note: The four-service case cycles over three service cores, identically for every variant.

measurement.metric: Established-connection whole-operation latency including result validation and cleanup; handshakes excluded
measurement.spread: Sample standard deviation of the five repetition means; not a confidence interval

outer_cgroup_note: Docker-visible cpu.max is unlimited; the enclosing execution environment has a four-CPU quota. Host-side snapshots are retained separately.
